entities.summary: Jean Joseph Henri Toussaint was a naturalists & biologists in Rouvres-la-Chétive (1847-04-30, Rouvres-la-Chétive – 1890-08-03) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with environmental and ecological history. Advanced biological classification and ecological understanding.
